prs.title: fix(nuxt,vite): show compile error overlay on client-only pages
prs.author: AndreyYolkin
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

Сloses #36439

### 📚 Description

This PR hardens reports dev server sends, fixing the situation where `nuxt:dev:error` might be not registered yet. New `nuxt:dev:error:ready` emits after error handler was registered, addressing specific page

## Changes made:
1. Added new hook `nuxt:dev:error:ready`, triggered during Nuxt client plugin initialization step
2. When triggered, callback checks if pendingOverlay exists and send it to specific page if it does
3. `vite.client.ready` was removed as superseded by a new one, webpack was also checked, PR doesn't introduce a regression against it

AI-disclosure: AI was used to find an issue and prepare a PR (then reviewed). All descriptions are hand-crafted

prs.title: fix(nuxt): await async layouts before navigation
prs.author: Mini-ghost

prs.title: fix(nuxt): leave a newer async data entry alone when an old one is taken off
prs.author: mansurkhoja
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

resolves #36435

### 📚 Description

When a page that uses `useNuxtData(key)` is disposed, it calls `_off()` of the entry it found for the key. If this entry is old (already taken off) and another page has already created a new entry for the same key, `_off()` changes the new entry: it sets `_init = false`, deletes its promise from `_asyncDataPromises` and clears it in `nextTick`. The new entry stays at `idle`, and the result of its request is dropped.

This PR makes `_off()` return right after it unsubscribes from `app:data:refresh` if `nuxtApp._asyncData[key]` is not its own entry, so the newer entry is not touched.

The new test in `test/nuxt/use-async-data.test.ts` fails without the change (`_init` of the new entry becomes `false`) and passes with it. `pnpm test:runtime` passes.
